claims.text: The hotel is at Corso di Porta Nuova 1 in central Milan, close to Teatro alla Scala and a few steps from the major fashion streets.

findings.quote: Corso di Porta Nuova, 1 - 20121
Find Palazzo Parigi in Milan city centre
Our Hotel is close to Teatro alla Scala and few steps away from the major fashion streets

claims.text: It sits next to the Brera arts district, and the Brera Art Gallery on Via Brera is not far away.

findings.quote: next to the Brera arts district
At Via Brera, not far from Palazzo Parigi, you will find the Brera Art Gallery

claims.text: The hotel was designed by its owner, the Italian architect Paola Giambelli, who also manages it.

findings.quote: Meticulously designed and passionately managed by the inspirational Italian architect and owner, Paola Giambelli

claims.text: The interiors have marble floors and a sweeping staircase, and the lobby has Murano chandeliers and marble pillars.

findings.quote: find a private palace with dazzling marble floors, a sweeping staircase
The sweeping staircase, Murano chandeliers and marble pillars in the lobby

claims.text: The rooms were designed by Paola Giambelli together with Paris-based designer Pierre-Yves Rochon.

findings.quote: rooms by architect-owner Paola Giambelli and Paris based designer Pierre-Yves Rochon

claims.text: Rooms come in a Milanese style, more contemporary with cream furnishings and natural wood, or a classically chic Parisian style.

findings.quote: in either a Milanese or Parisian style. The former are more contemporary with cream furnishings and natural wooden fittings while our Parisian rooms are designed with a classically chic feel.

claims.text: Caffe Parigi, the hotel's cafe and bar, is filled with natural light and draws a local crowd.

findings.quote: Bistrot Lounge “Caffé Parigi”
Effortlessly stylish and flooded with natural light, our chic café and bar draws a lively local crowd.

claims.text: Afternoon tea is served in Caffe Parigi or out in the private garden.

findings.quote: Sit in our lovely private garden or share this spoiling experience with friends in Caffè Parigi.

claims.text: The Grand Spa has a large swimming pool, and its hammam can also be booked for private hire.

findings.quote: Large swimming pool
Hammam (also available for private hire)

claims.text: The spa's fitness area gets plenty of natural daylight.

findings.quote: Our 300 sqm space with plenty of natural daylight is a pleasant, airy place to work out.

claims.text: The spa offers Valmont anti-aging treatments.

findings.quote: Grand Spa & Valmont
Valmont has dedicated its savoir-faire to the field of anti-aging, offering professional treatments

claims.text: A large private garden dating back to the 18th century, with statues and the shade of ancient trees, sits within the hotel.

findings.quote: Adorned with elegant statues and ornaments, find our large private garden that dates back to the 18th century, shaded by ancient trees

claims.text: The Imperial Suite has Duomo views and a private jacuzzi and hammam, and can be joined with two other rooms to form a three-bedroom apartment.

findings.quote: Find spellbinding Duomo views, priceless artworks and a private jacuzzi and Hamman in a suite that can be coupled with two other rooms to create a spacious three bedroom apartment.

claims.text: The spa's Royal Hammam Suite is a Moroccan-style space with Moorish architecture and pink marble.

findings.quote: Discover a Moroccan style sanctuary with delicate Moorish architecture and glistening pink marble.

claims.text: Every bedroom has a terrace or balcony, many with views of the Duomo, the Sforzesco Castle or the Porta Nuova skyline.

findings.quote: Terraces and balconies come with every bedroom, many with unmissable city views of the Duomo, the Sforzesco Castle or the Porta Nuova skyline.

claims.text: In the Gastronomic Restaurant, dishes are delivered through a culinary catwalk.

findings.quote: Here, inside one of Milan’s best restaurants, find a fusion of exceptional taste and the finest cuisine, delivered with show-stopping drama through a unique culinary catwalk.

claims.text: Views vary by room: many bedrooms look over the city, while some, such as Premium Rooms, may face the courtyard instead.

findings.quote: many with unmissable city views
Generous on space, light filled with floor to ceiling windows and exciting city or cool courtyard views from a large private balcony.

claims.text: The two room styles differ, contemporary Milanese or classic Parisian, so it is worth asking for the one you prefer.

findings.quote: in either a Milanese or Parisian style. The former are more contemporary with cream furnishings and natural wooden fittings while our Parisian rooms are designed with a classically chic feel.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the exclusive positioning.
